title: The Blue Bags
chapters: Mina woke up early in the morning. The sky was bright, and the air was warm. A family day was ready to begin at Maple House. Mina felt tired, but the park made her feel happy.
Mina put on a blue shirt and a red hat. In the kitchen, Daddy had bread, fruit, cheese, and milk on the table. Mina checked bread off on the lunch page. Daddy and Mina put lunch together.

Joon came to the house with a black bag. Mina got on with Joon, and they laughed as they made lunch. Joon put cake in the black bag, and Mina put bread in the blue bag. Daddy put cold milk in the blue bag.
A bus was at the road at Maple House. Mina and Joon carried the bags to the bus. They set out for the park with Daddy and a little dog. The city was busy, and the bus was full.

At the park, Joon put the blue bag on a bench at a tall tree. A boy and his father had a blue camera bag at the bench. The camera bag looked like the lunch bag. Daddy was at the tree and read a newspaper.

A bus dropped Leo off at the park. Leo came with his father and put the camera bag at the bench. The camera bag was blue and big, and the lunch bag was blue and big. Leo took Mina's bag as his father called.

The dog came to Mina, and she began to look for the blue lunch bag. She found a blue bag, but it held a camera, a notebook, and a letter. Joon checked the black bag and found the cake. Their lunch was gone.
Mina and Joon had to get back to the park office. Daddy was with the dog, and the children carried the camera bag. A warm rain began on the road. Mina covered the letter with her red hat.
At the office, Mina went through the camera, notebook, and letter. A wet paper was in the notebook. Mina made out a name on the paper. The name was Leo.

Mina had to turn to the woman at the office for help. The woman called the market and gave Leo's name. A family with that name was at the market office. Mina and Joon took the camera bag and went there.
Mina and Joon came upon Leo at the market office. Leo held their blue lunch bag in his hands. His father held a map of the park. Leo looked at Mina's red hat and knew her.
Leo had seen Mina around the market with Daddy. Mina knew Leo from the bakery at the market. Mina gave Leo the camera bag. Leo was happy to see his camera.
Mina brought up the blue bags, and Leo listened. Leo had taken Mina's lunch bag. He had found bread and milk in it. His father had called the park office.
The children worked out a plan for the bags. They talked the plan over at a table. Leo put a red name on his camera bag. Mina put a black name on her lunch bag.
Leo gave the lunch bag back to Mina. Mina gave the camera bag to Leo. The cake was good in Joon's black bag. The children began to laugh as they saw the blue bags.
The rain ended as Mina and Joon left the market office. They got about the city in a bus. Leo and his father took a red car to the bakery. Mina and Joon planned to meet the family at the park.
On the bus, Joon looked at his hands and became quiet. The black cake bag was gone. Joon had left it at the market office or on the bus. Mina called the bus office from the market.
The bus office called Mina back in a short time. A bus woman had found the black bag and was taking it to the bakery. The cake was in the bag. Mina and Joon were at the bakery door.
A young bus woman came forward with the black bag. Joon was happy and checked the cake. The bus woman put the bag in a cold room. The cake looked good.
Mina looked around the bakery for Leo. Leo turned up with a red pen and paper. Mina wrote on the lunch bag, Leo wrote on the camera bag, and Joon wrote on the cake bag. The bags had names.
The families carried on with the family day at the park. They took the bags to the old bench. Daddy and the dog were at the tree. Daddy began to laugh as he heard of Leo and the blue bags.

Sara came to the park with her family. Mina and Sara had not met for a year, and they caught up at lunch. Sara read the letter from the camera bag and laughed. The children sat at a long table in the garden.

The families ordered in a warm meal from the restaurant. A woman brought potatoes, fruit, and bread. The families got together at the table. Leo's father played a guitar, and a little girl began to dance.
Their long walk paid off as the bags were on the table. Mina ate a red apple, and Joon cut the cake. Leo gave the dog a small ball. The park was full of light, a guitar, and happy talk.

At the end of the day, Mina checked the names on the bags. Leo had his camera, Mina had the lunch, and Joon had the cake. The blue bags looked new with their names. The families took a picture at the tree.
At night, Mina looked back on the day at her desk. The blue bags had made a difficult day, but the day had a good end. Mina had a new picture of Leo's family. She put it at the clock.
In the morning, Leo brought Mina's notebook round to Maple House. Mina had left it in the camera bag at the market office. Mina gave Leo cake. They talked with Daddy in the kitchen.
Mina cleaned the bag out in the garden. She found a little red ball in a pocket. The dog had put the ball there at the park. Mina put water on the bag and left it in the warm air.
Mina wrote a short letter to the bus office and the young bus woman. She wrote of the black bag and the cake. Mina signed off with her name. Daddy took the letter to the bus office.
Mina read a funny newspaper page to wind down. The moon was bright at the window, and Maple House was quiet. Mina put the blue bag at the door. She went to bed, and the long day ended.
